title: POST-FREEZE (addendum_1, descriptive): Static DIRTY under the tool-verdict reading (X02 vs F01) and statically clean but incorrect artifacts (X04)
notes: F01 only = artifacts DIRTY under the frozen rule (findings of any entry state) but not under X02 (only COMPLETED / PARTIAL entries count): X02 DIRTY = F01 DIRTY - F01 only (checked); X04 denominator = the artifacts failing Q06 of the same population (Q06 denominator - pass, checked); the DIRTY composition per tool is T12b, X05 is T12c.

POST-FREEZE (study_analysis_001.addendum_1, DECLARED_AFTER_DRY_RUN, declared 2026-10-17; descriptive, not part of the frozen methodology): X02 three_state_tool_verdict_reading - post-freeze sensitivity of the F01 rule conflict documented in normalize.py (170 artifacts in the dry run, all build_failed, clang_tidy NOT_ANALYZED entries); X04 statically_clean_but_incorrect - post-freeze descriptive (the frozen methodology named the goal but defined no metric)
BL01: Includes dense_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10.

IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test_feedback and combined_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped_tests_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction.

IC4: DIRTY means at least one finding the frozen tool configuration marks blocking (dominated by clang-tidy bugprone heuristics, see X03), not a confirmed defect; under the frozen rule findings of entries in analysis-gap states count (sensitivity X02).

IC6: static_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.

definitions.text: BASE: the 1,980 base cells (pilot_002 396 + full_ext_001 1,584), iteration-0 artifacts (use: initial code quality)

FINAL: for variant v: per base cell the artifact of the trajectory's terminal iteration (== STEP[v][2]); for trajectories terminal at iteration 0 the final artifact IS the base artifact (use: repair outcome per strategy on the identical 1,980-cell cohort)
F01 static_verdict_three_state: numerator = artifacts per state; denominator = artifacts; unit = artifact.
X02 three_state_tool_verdict_reading: numerator = artifacts per state (DIRTY, CLEAN_COMPLETE, NO_FINDING_INCOMPLETE); denominator = artifacts; unit = artifact.

X04 statically_clean_but_incorrect: numerator = FINAL artifacts with Q06 not pass and F01 == CLEAN_COMPLETE (resp. NO_FINDING_INCOMPLETE); denominator = FINAL artifacts with Q06 not pass (verdict not baseline_incompatible); unit = artifact.

ci_note: 95% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted); 2 interval(s) rest on fewer usable replicates (resamples with a zero denominator skipped and counted in the estimate note; at least 1,939 used); 1 interval(s) of zero width marked †
